mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, name, display_name, description, is_system, member_count, last_message_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_channels (workspace_id, name, display_name, description, is_system, member_count, created_by) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{isSystem}, #{memberCount}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_channels WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY is_system DESC, name ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_channels SET display_name = #{displayName}, description = #{description}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.channel_id = #{channelId} AND m.id > COALESCE( (SELECT c.last_read_message_id FROM chat_read_cursors c WHERE c.channel_id = #{channelId} AND c.user_id = #{userId}), 0)
